meta.requirement: Explore Whispering Woods (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Slime Rancher
start.text:
''A burst of cold air hits you first, then a wall of heat, then a low whirling sound that makes the leaves spin in tight circles.''

''You round a bend in the path and find a man on one knee in the dirt, arms thrown around a large cloth-wrapped package. Three slimes press in from different angles: a pale blue one trailing frost, a red one flickering with heat, a pale green one that keeps circling in little gusts. The man is clutching the package so tightly his knuckles are white.''

Tobias: ''through clenched teeth'' Not the package. Not the package.

step_in.text:
''You draw your weapon. The anemo slime spins toward you first, scattering grit. The pyro one pulses with heat. The cryo one has stopped moving entirely, which somehow feels worse.''

''The man looks up at you. He has a cut above one eye and a burn on his forearm. His expression is something between relief and disbelief.''

Tobias: You're going to fight them? ''short pause'' Good. Great. Please.

can_u_stand.text: Tobias: ''tries and doesn't quite manage it'' Mostly. ''winces'' My ankle caught something when I went down. I'm fine, I just can't... ''the cryo slime drifts closer'' Right. Not the time. Go.

Get_clear_I_will_handle_this.text:
Tobias: ''drags the package behind the nearest tree trunk, still not letting go of it''

''The three slimes turn to face you fully. The pyro one pops and crackles. The cryo one exhales a fine mist. The anemo one lifts off the ground a little, spinning faster.''

''You grip your weapon. Three at once. Fine.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the slimes attacking the man in the Whispering Woods

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Fight the Slimes. Defeat 1 [[Cryo Slime]], 1 [[Pyro Slime]], and 1 [[Anemo Slime]]

kill_slimes.text:
''The clearing settles. The slimes are gone.''

''Behind you, Tobias peers out from behind the tree with an expression that is clearly trying to look calm.''

Tobias: ...They're dead? ''looks around the path carefully'' They're dead.

''He slumps back against the bark. The package is still clamped under his arm.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Talk to the man you just rescued

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Check on the Man

slime_killed_baby.text:
''Tobias lets out a long, slow breath and tips his head back.''

Tobias: Right. Okay. ''looks at you'' That was. A lot. I've done this stretch of path thirty times and I have never, not once, had three of them at the same time. ''attempts to stand, catches himself with a grunt'' Ow.

''He looks down at his ankle, then at the burn on his arm.''

how_bad.text:
Tobias: The ankle's twisted, not broken. The burn's ugly but I've had worse from a campfire. ''glances at his arm'' And the cut just looks dramatic. I'll live.

''He finally, carefully, sets the package down and flexes his hand. He's been holding it that tight for a while.''

Tobias: The package, though. ''exhales'' The package is fine. That's what matters.

whats_in.text:
Tobias: ''slightly guilty look'' Glassware. Custom. For a commission. ''he pats the cloth'' Double-wrapped, packed in sawdust, and I have been terrified of dropping it since I left Mondstadt. Sliding down that hill to avoid a slime, that was the worst three seconds of my life.

''He pauses.''

Tobias: Don't tell the client.

Where_are_you_delivering_it.text:
Tobias: Springvale. A farm on the east side. They ordered it weeks ago and it's already late. ''he tests his weight on his ankle, hisses'' ...That's not happening. Not today.

''He looks at the package. Then at you. Then back at the package.''

choices.label: You're going to ask me to carry it, aren't you?
I could help you get there

You_are_going_to_ask_me_to_carry_it_aren.text:
Tobias: ''a little sheepish'' I am. Yeah. I will pay you when you get back, I promise. Two hundred silver. That's a real offer, not desperation money. ''quickly'' I mean, it's also desperation, a little. But the rate is fair.

''He holds out the package with both hands.''

Tobias: Ask for Marta at the east farm. She'll know what it is. You can't miss the house, it's the one with the big water wheel.

choices.label: Two hundred silver. I'll do it
You don't have to pay me

Two_hundred_silver__I_will_do_it.text:
Tobias: ''leans back against the tree, already looking exhausted'' I'll wait here. Or... ''glances at the path'' Maybe a bit closer to the road. ''to himself'' Yeah. Closer to the road is better.

''He gathers himself carefully, favoring the good ankle.''

Tobias: Thank you. I mean it.

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver the Package to Marta

dont_have_to_pay.text: Tobias: ''shakes his head firmly'' No. You fought off three slimes for a stranger and now you're carrying his glassware across the woods. You are getting paid. ''he puts the package in your hands before you can argue further'' Marta. East farm. Water wheel. Two hundred silver when you're back.

to_spring.text:
''The east farm is easy enough to find. The water wheel turns slowly over a narrow stream, and the smell of fresh bread drifts from the windows.''

''At the door, a woman with flour on her apron looks at the package in your arms and her face does something complicated.''

Marta: Oh. Oh, it's here. ''she takes it with both hands, carefully'' He actually managed it. I told Aldwin the man would come through.

''She sets it just inside the door and turns back to you with a smaller parcel.''

Marta: He said someone else might be delivering. Here, for your trouble. And tell him to rest that ankle properly, I know he won't.

i_will.text:
''You find Tobias sitting on a fence post near the edge of the Springvale road, very carefully not putting weight on his ankle. He straightens when he sees you.''

Tobias: You got it there? ''the relief on his face is genuine'' Marta wasn't furious?

''He reaches into his coat and counts out a small stack of silver.''

Tobias: Two hundred. ''holds it out'' You earned every bit of it.

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.text:
''You take the silver. Tobias nods, looking like a man who has just set down something very heavy.''

Tobias: Good. ''a beat'' I'm going to sit here for another ten minutes and then very slowly find somewhere to eat.

''He waves a hand in a tired farewell.''

''The silver is in your pocket. The glassware is delivered. In the distance, Springvale carries on like nothing happened.''

keep_it.text:
''You hold the silver back out to him.''

Tobias: ''stares at it'' ...No. ''pushes your hand back, gently but firmly'' I fought three slimes today and lost. You fought three slimes today and won. That is a different category of person.

''He counts out another hundred silver from deeper in the same coat pocket.''

Tobias: Take the extra hundred too. For the hassle. And because I want to, so don't argue with me about it.

''He puts all three hundred in your hand and closes your fingers around it.''

Tobias: There. ''satisfied'' Now we're both happy.

Delivered_Generously.title: Delivered, Generously
Delivered_Generously.text:
Tobias: ''waves it off, already settling back onto the fence post'' Don't mention it. Seriously, I'd like to never mention any part of today again.

''He tilts his face up toward the afternoon sun, visibly decompressing.''

Tobias: Come back through Springvale some time. I'll probably be here. ''quietly'' I always end up back through Springvale.

''You leave him there, three hundred silver heavier, the fence post creaking faintly in the breeze.''
